title: Defcon 18 - Practical Cellphone Spying - Chris Paget - Part.mov
summary: Chris Paget's DEF CON 18 talk on practical cellphone spying, showing how GSM traffic can be intercepted with a fake base station. It covers 2G interception and the weaknesses of cellular networks.
why: HN points to it as a worrying but technically solid explanation of how cell interception works, even if the talk is old.
